name: Home Assistant iOS (arm64, zero-config)
description: https://github.com/home-assistant/iOS: an .xcodeproj with a large app target, a shared framework (Shared) ~550 app files import, many extensions and Swift packages, and script phases (SwiftGen and others); not seen while xcfs was developed.

plain.build: xcodebuild build -project HomeAssistant.xcodeproj -scheme 'App-Debug' -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64

edits.name: edit a function body in the app target
edit a function body in a framework ~550 app files import (Shared)
add a public declaration to that framework
